chars.MARIA: MARIA: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow blazer over a white blouse, black trousers, large round red glasses, a small notebook.
chars.SIMO: SIMO: a young man wearing a dark green bomber jacket, light-blue jeans, white sneakers and a silver wristwatch.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: SIMO walks up a sunny modern Casablanca street towards the glass door of a small office building, looking hesitant and a little shy.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MARIA sits at her bright modern office desk in Casablanca, answering a phone call with a warm professional smile, a laptop and a plant on the desk.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SIMO enters MARIA's cozy office and sits stiffly on the edge of a velvet armchair, nervous, hands on his knees, while MARIA sits facing him with her notebook.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MARIA leans forward smiling kindly, opening her hand to invite SIMO to talk; SIMO sits on the armchair across from her, relaxing a little.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: SIMO introduces himself confidently, hand on his chest, while MARIA listens and writes in her notebook.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: SIMO in a busy New York street with tall skyscrapers and yellow taxis, holding a coffee and a laptop bag, walking to work.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SIMO stands proudly in his own modern office with big windows, colleagues working in the background, shaking hands with a client.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Back in the office: MARIA raises an eyebrow, puzzled, tapping her pen on her chin, while SIMO shrugs with open hands, looking lost.
